scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && vitest run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsx scripts/test-integration.ts
scripts.demo:seed: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run demo:seed -w apps/api
